# 'Gasoil/Diesel (7 ppm)', a specification the report has never printed and
# that PRODUCT_LABELS therefore does not know. Every other row, number and
# column is untouched, so the only thing that can fail is the label match.

# parser that read the block by position would hand back a 7 ppm gasoil under
# the 10 ppm column and nothing downstream would notice. This one must refuse
# the whole issue and say which label it did not recognise.
